description: DSA Mastery Platform - 150 Problem Curriculum Manifest

categories.name: Foundations
categories.description: Core data structures and fundamental patterns

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.reasonForSelection: Foundational complement-finding pattern; introduces hash map trade-off; appears in 3Sum, 4Sum, subarray sum problems

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.reasonForSelection: Simplest hash map frequency problem; teaches set vs map trade-offs

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic frequency counting; introduces character array vs hash map for fixed alphabet

problems.title: Group Anagrams
problems.reasonForSelection: Extends frequency counting to grouping; teaches hash map with array/list values

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.reasonForSelection: Combines frequency counting with heap selection; teaches bucket sort alternative O(n)

problems.title: Product of Array Except Self
problems.reasonForSelection: Teaches prefix/suffix pattern without division; O(n) time, O(1) space (excluding output)

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.reasonForSelection: Kadane's algorithm - foundational DP on arrays; teaches local vs global optimum

problems.title: Maximum Product Subarray
problems.reasonForSelection: Extends Kadane to track both min and max due to negative multiplication

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.reasonForSelection: Teaches binary search on rotated arrays; finding inflection point

problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.reasonForSelection: Binary search with rotated array; determines which half is sorted

categories.name: Two Pointers
categories.description: Two pointer techniques for arrays and strings

problems.title: Valid Palindrome
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic two-pointer string problem; teaches filtering + two pointers

problems.title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
problems.reasonForSelection: Shows how sorted input enables O(1) space two-pointer vs O(n) hash map

problems.title: Container With Most Water
problems.reasonForSelection: Greedy two-pointer optimization; proves moving smaller height is optimal

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
problems.reasonForSelection: Multiple approaches (two-pointer, prefix/suffix, stack); teaches space-time trade-offs

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.reasonForSelection: Generalizes two-sum to 3Sum; teaches sorting + two-pointer + deduplication

problems.title: 4Sum
problems.reasonForSelection: Generalizes to k-sum pattern; recursive k-sum template

categories.name: Sliding Window
categories.description: Fixed and variable sliding window techniques

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problems.reasonForSelection: Simplest single-pass tracking; teaches min-so-far pattern

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic variable sliding window with hash map; teaches window expansion/contraction

problems.title: Longest Substring with At Most K Distinct Characters
problems.reasonForSelection: Generalizes distinct character constraint; introduces frequency map in window

problems.title: Minimum Window Substring
problems.reasonForSelection: Most complex sliding window; teaches required/formed counters and contraction logic

problems.title: Permutation in String
problems.reasonForSelection: Fixed window size = len(s1); teaches array vs hash map for fixed alphabet

problems.title: Find All Anagrams in a String
problems.reasonForSelection: Returns all start indices; extends fixed window to collect all matches

problems.title: Sliding Window Maximum
problems.reasonForSelection: Introduces monotonic deque for O(n) sliding window max; key advanced DS technique

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.reasonForSelection: Fundamental binary search implementation; teaches loop invariants

problems.title: Search Insert Position
problems.reasonForSelection: Teaches lower bound binary search; returns insertion point when not found

problems.title: First Bad Version
problems.reasonForSelection: API-based binary search; finds first true in monotonic predicate

problems.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
problems.reasonForSelection: Teaches both lower_bound and upper_bound; range query via binary search

problems.title: Koko Eating Bananas
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic binary search on answer space; monotonic predicate: can eat in H hours

problems.title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
problems.reasonForSelection: Another binary search on answer; capacity as search space, days as predicate

problems.title: Split Array Largest Sum
problems.reasonForSelection: Harder binary search on answer; also solvable with DP for comparison

problems.title: Minimum Number of Days to Make M Bouquets
problems.reasonForSelection: Bloom day as search space; consecutive flowers constraint adds complexity

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.reasonForSelection: Finds inflection point in rotated array; key insight: compare mid with right

problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.reasonForSelection: Search target in rotated array; determine which half is sorted

problems.title: Find Peak Element
problems.reasonForSelection: Binary search on peak property; any peak is valid, not necessarily global max

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.reasonForSelection: Fundamental linked list merge; teaches dummy head pattern and pointer manipulation

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.reasonForSelection: Core linked list reversal; both iterative and recursive approaches essential

problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.reasonForSelection: Introduces Floyd's cycle detection; foundational for many linked list problems

problems.title: Linked List Cycle II
problems.reasonForSelection: Extends cycle detection to find cycle entry point; mathematical proof insight

problems.title: Reorder List
problems.reasonForSelection: Combines find middle + reverse + merge; classic multi-technique linked list problem

problems.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
problems.reasonForSelection: Fast-slow with n-gap; teaches dummy head for edge case handling

problems.title: Copy List with Random Pointer
problems.reasonForSelection: Teaches two approaches: hash map O(n) space vs interleaving O(1) space

problems.title: Add Two Numbers
problems.reasonForSelection: Linked list arithmetic; teaches carry handling and dummy head pattern

problems.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
problems.reasonForSelection: Generalizes merge to k lists; teaches heap vs divide-and-conquer trade-offs

problems.title: Sort List
problems.reasonForSelection: Merge sort on linked list; O(n log n) time, O(log n) space recursion

categories.name: Trees
categories.description: Binary tree and general tree algorithms

problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.reasonForSelection: Simplest tree recursion; teaches both DFS and BFS approaches

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.reasonForSelection: Teaches BST property validation with bounds; alternative inorder traversal approach

problems.title: Symmetric Tree
problems.reasonForSelection: Mirror tree comparison; teaches pairwise recursive/iterative traversal

problems.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
problems.reasonForSelection: Standard BFS level-order; foundation for many tree level problems

problems.title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
problems.reasonForSelection: Extends level-order with alternating direction; teaches deque for efficient reversal

problems.title: Binary Tree Right Side View
problems.reasonForSelection: Rightmost node per level; teaches BFS level tracking and DFS pre-order with depth

problems.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
problems.reasonForSelection: Post-order traversal with global max; teaches computing path through node

problems.title: Balanced Binary Tree
problems.reasonForSelection: Early exit post-order; teaches returning sentinel value (-1) for unbalanced

problems.title: Invert Binary Tree
problems.reasonForSelection: Simple tree mutation; teaches pre-order swap pattern

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic LCA post-order; teaches single traversal finding split point

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
problems.reasonForSelection: Leverages BST property for O(h) iterative solution; contrasts with general tree LCA

problems.title: Number of Islands
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic grid DFS/BFS; introduces grid as implicit graph; union-find alternative

problems.title: Max Area of Island
problems.reasonForSelection: Extends island counting to area computation; same traversal with accumulator

problems.title: Clone Graph
problems.reasonForSelection: Graph deep copy with cycles; teaches hash map for visited/original->clone mapping

problems.title: Course Schedule
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic topological sort (Kahn's BFS) and DFS cycle detection; detects DAG

problems.title: Course Schedule II
problems.reasonForSelection: Returns actual ordering; extends Kahn's algorithm to build result array

problems.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
problems.reasonForSelection: Multi-source reverse flow from oceans; teaches running DFS/BFS from boundaries inward

problems.title: Surrounded Regions
problems.reasonForSelection: Boundary-first traversal; mark border-connected O's, flip rest; reverse thinking

problems.title: Rotting Oranges
problems.reasonForSelection: Multi-source BFS with time tracking; teaches level-by-level time propagation

problems.title: Walls and Gates
problems.reasonForSelection: Same multi-source BFS pattern; fill distances from gates instead of rotting

problems.title: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
problems.reasonForSelection: General graph (not grid) connected components; three approaches comparison

problems.title: Graph Valid Tree
problems.reasonForSelection: Tree = connected + acyclic; teaches both DFS cycle detection and Union-Find

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.reasonForSelection: Simplest DP problem; Fibonacci recurrence; teaches bottom-up vs top-down

problems.title: House Robber
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic 1D DP with adjacent constraint; dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i])

problems.title: House Robber II
problems.reasonForSelection: Circular array variant; run twice (exclude first, exclude last) and take max

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.reasonForSelection: Unbounded knapsack; minimum coins for amount; teaches complete knapsack pattern

problems.title: Coin Change II
problems.reasonForSelection: Number of combinations (not permutations); outer loop coins, inner loop amount

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic LIS; O(n²) DP and O(n log n) patience sorting; two important approaches

problems.title: Maximum Sum Increasing Subsequence
problems.reasonForSelection: LIS variant maximizing sum instead of length; same O(n²) structure

problems.title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
problems.reasonForSelection: Fibonacci variant with cost; can start at step 0 or 1; teaches DP base cases

problems.title: Delete and Earn
problems.reasonForSelection: Transforms to House Robber on value frequencies; teaches problem reduction

problems.title: Unique Paths
problems.reasonForSelection: Simplest 2D grid DP; dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1]; also combinatorics solution

problems.title: Unique Paths II
problems.reasonForSelection: Adds obstacles to grid DP; teaches handling blocked cells in DP

problems.title: Minimum Path Sum
problems.reasonForSelection: Minimization instead of counting; same grid structure with min instead of sum

problems.title: Dungeon Game
problems.reasonForSelection: Reverse DP from bottom-right; teaches thinking backwards for minimum health

problems.title: Edit Distance
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic string DP; insert/delete/replace operations; foundation for string similarity

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.reasonForSelection: Fundamental string DP; builds on edit distance; space optimization possible

problems.title: Distinct Subsequences
problems.reasonForSelection: Count distinct subsequences matching target; similar to LCS but counting

problems.title: Interleaving String
problems.reasonForSelection: 2D DP on three strings; checks if s3 is interleaving of s1 and s2

problems.title: Regular Expression Matching
problems.reasonForSelection: Complex regex with '.' and '*'; 2D DP with careful star handling

problems.title: Wildcard Matching
problems.reasonForSelection: Wildcard with '?' and '*'; both DP and greedy two-pointer approaches

problems.title: Burst Balloons
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic interval DP; optimal substructure on subarrays; teaches length-based iteration

problems.title: Shortest Path Visiting All Nodes
problems.reasonForSelection: BFS + bitmask state; traveling salesman on small graphs (n<=12)

problems.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic interval scheduling; sort by end time, pick maximum non-overlapping

problems.title: Meeting Rooms
problems.reasonForSelection: Simple overlap detection; sort by start time, check adjacent

problems.title: Meeting Rooms II
problems.reasonForSelection: Min rooms = max concurrent meetings; min-heap tracks earliest ending

problems.title: Task Scheduler
problems.reasonForSelection: Greedy with max-heap for most frequent; also mathematical formula solution

problems.title: Jump Game
problems.reasonForSelection: Greedy from right to left tracking furthest reachable; O(n) vs O(n²) DP

problems.title: Jump Game II
problems.reasonForSelection: Minimum jumps; greedy BFS-like level traversal; current end, furthest reach

problems.title: Gas Station
problems.reasonForSelection: Circular tour; if total gas >= total cost, solution exists; track tank deficit

problems.title: Candy
problems.reasonForSelection: Two-pass greedy; left-to-right for left neighbor, right-to-left for right neighbor

problems.title: Subsets
problems.reasonForSelection: Fundamental backtracking; generate all 2^n subsets; three approaches

problems.title: Subsets II
problems.reasonForSelection: Handles duplicates in input; sort and skip duplicates at same level

problems.title: Permutations
problems.reasonForSelection: Generate all n! permutations; swap-based vs visited-array approaches

problems.title: Permutations II
problems.reasonForSelection: Permutations with duplicates; sort and skip used duplicates

problems.title: Combinations
problems.reasonForSelection: Choose k from n; fundamental combination generation with start index

problems.title: Combination Sum
problems.reasonForSelection: Unlimited use of candidates; target sum; classic backtracking with target

problems.title: Combination Sum II
problems.reasonForSelection: Each candidate used once; sort and skip duplicates at same level

problems.title: Palindrome Partitioning
problems.reasonForSelection: Backtracking with palindrome checking; can optimize with DP precomputation

problems.title: N-Queens
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic constraint satisfaction; columns + diagonals tracking; bitmask optimization

categories.name: Trie
categories.description: Trie (prefix tree) data structure and applications

problems.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
problems.reasonForSelection: Core trie implementation; insert, search, startsWith; foundation for all trie problems

problems.title: Add and Search Word - Data structure design
problems.reasonForSelection: Trie with wildcard '.' search; DFS with backtracking for dot matching

problems.title: Word Search II
problems.reasonForSelection: Multiple word search on grid using trie; prunes search by shared prefixes

problems.title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in an Array
problems.reasonForSelection: Bitwise trie for maximum XOR pair; greedy bit-by-bit from MSB

problems.title: Replace Words
problems.reasonForSelection: Dictionary shortest prefix replacement; trie for prefix matching

categories.name: Heap / Priority Queue
categories.description: Heap data structure and priority queue applications

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
problems.reasonForSelection: Min-heap of size k for top k; quickselect O(n) average alternative

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.reasonForSelection: Frequency + heap for top k; bucket sort O(n) alternative

problems.title: Find Median from Data Stream
problems.reasonForSelection: Two heaps (max-heap for lower half, min-heap for upper half); balance sizes

problems.title: Sliding Window Median
problems.reasonForSelection: Two heaps with lazy deletion for sliding window; multiset alternative

problems.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
problems.reasonForSelection: Min-heap for k-way merge; divide-and-conquer O(n log k) alternative

problems.title: Find K Pairs with Smallest Sums
problems.reasonForSelection: Min-heap for k smallest pairs from two sorted arrays; pushes (i,j) pairs

problems.title: Daily Temperatures
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic monotonic decreasing stack for next greater element; O(n) single pass

problems.title: Next Greater Element I
problems.reasonForSelection: Subset array next greater; build map from nums2 using monotonic stack

problems.title: Next Greater Element II
problems.reasonForSelection: Circular array; iterate 2n times or use modulo; classic circular monotonic stack

problems.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problems.reasonForSelection: Monotonic increasing stack for nearest smaller left/right; area = height * width

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
problems.reasonForSelection: Three approaches: monotonic stack, two-pointer, prefix/suffix max; teaches trade-offs

problems.title: Maximal Rectangle
problems.reasonForSelection: Reduces to histogram per row; builds heights array and applies histogram algorithm

problems.title: Shortest Subarray with Sum at Least K
problems.reasonForSelection: Monotonic queue on prefix sums; handles negative numbers unlike sliding window

problems.title: Sum of Subarray Ranges
problems.reasonForSelection: Contribution technique; each element as min/max in how many subarrays

categories.name: Segment Tree / Binary Indexed Tree
categories.description: Segment tree and Fenwick tree for range queries

problems.title: Range Sum Query - Mutable
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic point update, range sum query; both segment tree and BIT implementations

problems.title: Range Sum Query 2D - Mutable
problems.reasonForSelection: Extends BIT/Segment Tree to 2D; matrix point updates and rectangle sum queries

problems.title: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self
problems.reasonForSelection: Coordinate compression + BIT/Segment Tree; or merge sort with inversion counting

problems.title: Reverse Pairs
problems.reasonForSelection: Count pairs with nums[i] > 2*nums[j]; merge sort or BIT with coordinate compression

problems.title: Count of Range Sum
problems.reasonForSelection: Count subarrays with sum in [lower, upper]; prefix sum + BIT/merge sort

problems.title: Single Number
problems.reasonForSelection: XOR cancels pairs; a^a=0, a^0=a; fundamental bit trick

problems.title: Single Number II
problems.reasonForSelection: Each bit appears 3 times except one; count bits modulo 3 or use state machine

problems.title: Single Number III
problems.reasonForSelection: Two unique numbers; XOR all to get a^b, find differing bit, partition and XOR

problems.title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in an Array
problems.reasonForSelection: Bitwise trie for maximum XOR pair; greedy bit-by-bit from MSB

problems.title: Reverse Bits
problems.reasonForSelection: Reverse 32-bit integer bits; loop or divide-and-conquer swap

problems.title: Number of 1 Bits
problems.reasonForSelection: Hamming weight; Brian Kernighan's algorithm n &= (n-1) clears lowest set bit

problems.title: Hamming Distance
problems.reasonForSelection: XOR reveals differing bits; popcount gives Hamming distance

problems.title: Sum of Two Integers
problems.reasonForSelection: Implement addition using only bitwise operators; carry = (a&b)<<1, sum = a^b

problems.title: Implement strStr()
problems.reasonForSelection: Substring search; KMP O(n+m) with LPS array; Rabin-Karp rolling hash

problems.title: Shortest Palindrome
problems.reasonForSelection: KMP on s + '#' + reverse(s); find longest palindromic prefix

problems.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
problems.reasonForSelection: Manacher's O(n) algorithm; expand around center O(n²) simpler alternative

problems.title: Minimum Window Substring
problems.reasonForSelection: Most complex sliding window; required/formed counters; contraction logic

categories.name: Design Problems
categories.description: System design and data structure design problems

problems.title: LRU Cache
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic LRU; hash map + doubly linked list for O(1) get/put; move to front on access

problems.title: LFU Cache
problems.reasonForSelection: Frequency-based eviction; hash map of frequency to doubly linked list; min frequency tracking

problems.title: Design HashMap
problems.reasonForSelection: Implement hash map from scratch; chaining vs open addressing; resizing

problems.title: Design Twitter
problems.reasonForSelection: Social media feed; follow/unfollow, post tweet, get news feed; heap merge for feed

problems.title: Design Search Autocomplete System
problems.reasonForSelection: Trie with frequency at each node; top 3 suggestions; real-time search

problems.title: Network Delay Time
problems.reasonForSelection: Classic Dijkstra single-source shortest path; signal propagation time in network

problems.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
problems.reasonForSelection: Shortest path with edge constraint (K stops); Bellman-Ford or modified Dijkstra

problems.title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
problems.reasonForSelection: Manhattan distance MST; Prim's O(n²) dense graph or Kruskal with all edges

problems.title: Swim in Rising Water
problems.reasonForSelection: Minimize maximum value on path; Dijkstra on grid or binary search + Union-Find

problems.title: Path With Minimum Effort
problems.reasonForSelection: Minimize maximum absolute difference; same techniques as Swim in Rising Water
